title: A copper ion gains electrons
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the model.

knows: Symbols can represent chemical substances or states.
doesNotKnow: The reduction half-reaction Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu shows a copper ion gaining two electrons. Electron gain is reduction; the number of protons does not change.

misconception: The process produces a different result from the one shown.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A Cu²⁺ ion becomes a neutral copper atom. What happens to its electrons? The reduction half-reaction Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu shows a copper ion gaining two electrons. Electron gain is reduction; the number of protons does not change.
The circles are symbolic labels, not molecular structures, and the model omits other conditions or intermediate steps.
